overall_goal: Add sweetcorn, beans, and chopped avocado to the salad bowl

goals.description: Open the tin of sweetcorn and add it to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person opens the sweetcorn tin, scoops it into a bowl on the scale, and then transfers it to the main salad bowl.

goals.description: Open and drain the tin of beans
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a can opener, makes multiple attempts to open the tin of beans, and then drains the liquid into the sink.

goals.description: Weigh and add the beans to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person pours and scoops the drained beans into a bowl on the scale, then transfers them to the main salad bowl.

goals.description: Chop, weigh, and add the avocado to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person cuts the avocado into chunks, weighs it, and scoops the chunks into the main salad bowl, removing any stray skin.
